target_semantics_lesson: The target is the monthly percentage change in US core CPI, focusing on its drivers and potential counteracting forces.
evidence_selection_lesson: Validate causal bridges by checking monthly shelter inflation, Services PPI, and core-services CPI, reconciling component changes to the published core CPI level.
causal_reasoning_lesson: Moderating shelter inflation and easing supply chains exert downward pressure, but persistent services inflation can counteract these effects, creating uncertainty.
counterevidence_lesson: Rising services inflation, indicated by Services PPI, acts as counterevidence to disinflationary trends, potentially keeping core CPI elevated.
calibration_lesson: Reduce confidence if services inflation momentum offsets shelter moderation or if component narratives fail to reconcile with the published core CPI index.
